howToRun: npm run test:e2e — uses the installed VS Code, a dedicated profile under .local/e2e-vscode, and copies the ms-dotnettools.vscode-dotnet-runtime dependency from the user profile when the marketplace install is unavailable.

rootCauseOfTheEarlierFailures.symptom: 5/7: the analysis never registered a result in the test instance.
rootCauseOfTheEarlierFailures.cause: The suite asserted immediately after the command returned, before the controller finished registering the result, and (in a later attempt) the diagnostics patch itself broke activation: assigning to vscode.OutputChannel.appendLine throws because the property is read-only, so the extension never activated.
rootCauseOfTheEarlierFailures.fix: The suite waits for the result after the command, and the output tail is captured by a thin wrapper object instead of patching the channel.

notVerifiedHere: Untrusted-workspace behaviour (the launcher disables workspace trust).
